family.tagline: A bike shop in the garage, with its customer list at home.
family.story: Solange runs a bicycle and e-bike repair shop out of the garage, and her son Mathis turns the wrenches. Every customer and every repair is written down in the house at the top of a long white stair. One Companion Core on a study shelf holds the lot.

companion.name: Margaux
companion.job: Drafts pickup notes and parts orders from what Solange texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Solange sends every message.

companion.name: Remy
companion.job: Opens Baserow in its own browser and logs parts as they arrive.
companion.limits: Logs what Mathis reads out. He checks the list.

popup.title: A parcel below the long stair
popup.body: A parcel waits at the foot of the long front stair. Mathis carries it up, through the entry hall, to the study. Solange clears a shelf.

popup.title: The parcel, unpacked on the shelf
popup.body: Solange sets out the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. Its footprint is about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Cable in, button pressed
popup.body: Mathis plugs in the cable and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Her phone joins the Core
popup.body: Solange joins the Core's own Wi-Fi network from her phone. Then she chooses the home network and types its password.

popup.title: Hermes, OpenClaw, two apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Solange picks Hermes and Mathis picks OpenClaw. They add EspoCRM and Baserow, then walk away.

beats.capability: runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Margaux says hello
popup.body: Solange texts the agent she named Margaux. Margaux answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: solange
say.text: Hello, Solange. I am Margaux. Which note first?

beats.capability: Find photos by face, object and place, with albums built by date and location

popup.title: Search the photos for bicycles
popup.body: Mathis types bicycle into LibrePhotos on the living-room TV. It finds photos by object, and the whole library sits on the Core.

beats.capability: Manage and read books, comics and PDFs

popup.title: The manual, read on the couch
popup.body: Solange reads a service manual in BookLore on the couch. It keeps her books and PDFs on the Core, ready for the next e-bike.

beats.capability: Send files between phones and laptops on the same Wi-Fi

popup.title: A cracked frame, sent across
popup.body: At dinner, Mathis photographs a cracked frame and sends it to his mother's laptop with PairDrop. It crosses the home Wi-Fi in one tap.

beats.capability: A shared household hub with a recipe book and an expiry tracker

popup.title: Her mother's pea soup, kept
popup.body: Solange types her mother's pea soup into the HomeHub recipe book. Its expiry tracker lists what to use first.

beats.capability: Assign and track household chores and recurring tasks, with NFC tag completion

popup.title: Dishes done, one tap
popup.body: Mathis taps a tag on the fridge when the dishes are done. Donetick closes the chore and keeps the household list.

beats.capability: Track accounts, budgets, bills and savings goals, with rules that sort your transactions

popup.title: The statement, sorted by rules
popup.body: At the counter, Solange imports the month's statement as a CSV file into Firefly III. Its rules sort the transactions.

beats.capability: runs in its own sandbox on your Core and talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Pickup notes, drafted
popup.body: Solange texts Margaux which bikes are ready. Margaux drafts a pickup note for each customer, and Solange reads and sends every one.

say.speaker: solange
say.text: These are drafts. Please read each one before you send it.

beats.capability: Send invoices and quotes, track expenses and time

popup.title: The invoice, drawn up at home
popup.body: Solange writes an e-bike service invoice in Invoice Ninja. The quote and the invoice sit on the Core, beside the customer's record.

beats.capability: Store every password in a vault you host. Works with the Bitwarden apps

popup.title: Supplier sign-ins off the sticky notes
popup.body: Solange moves the supplier sign-ins from sticky notes into VaultWarden. The vault works with the Bitwarden apps and lives on the Core.

beats.capability: A small CalDAV and CardDAV server for your calendars and contacts

popup.title: One calendar for shop hours
popup.body: E-bike fittings and shop hours go into one Baikal calendar. Solange and Mathis see the same week on their phones.

beats.capability: Manage customers, sales pipelines, campaigns and support cases in a CRM you host

popup.title: Her bike's history, at the counter
popup.body: A customer waits at the garage counter. Mathis opens her record in EspoCRM and finds a case for every past repair.

beats.capability: Build a no-code database for orders, inventory or projects

popup.title: Remy logs the brake pads
popup.body: A pallet of brake pads arrives. Mathis reads out the part numbers, and Remy logs each one in Baserow in its own browser. Mathis checks the list.

say.speaker: mathis
say.text: Brake pads logged. Please check the list.

beats.capability: A PDF toolkit that runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded

popup.title: Warranty and job sheet, one file
popup.body: Mathis merges the warranty form and the job sheet into one PDF with BentoPDF. The work happens in his browser, and nothing is uploaded.

beats.capability: A local video recorder with object detection for your IP cameras

popup.title: Clips from the drive stay home
popup.body: The family's IP camera watches the drive. Frigate keeps the clips on the Core, and Mathis plays them back on the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: Track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: A journal for the cypress
popup.body: Solange logs the new arborvitae in HortusFox. She notes when she watered it and adds a photo to the garden journal.

beats.capability: Plan, map and share hiking and biking routes from GPX files

popup.title: Saturday ride, planned on the patio
popup.body: On the patio, Mathis loads a GPX file into Wanderer and plans the Saturday ride. The map and the route stay on the Core.

popup.title: One Core, one bike shop
popup.body: From the garage to the study, the Dufresne household runs the shop and the house from one Core.

closing.body: Your customers, your repair history and your parts list can run on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: FTUE follows the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 7); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is still open.
Remy's job in cast.json named HomeBox, which has no QA screenshot (a review item). The job now names Baserow, which keeps the parts-bin story and has a screenshot. HomeBox is not used.
garden-drive assumes the family owns an IP camera (not in the Core parcel, not in the 3D scene). No claim that it prevents anything. Viewing away from home is not shown.
The shop is the garage, but customers come to the house: the counter beat shows a customer at the garage counter, never a public website or a booking page.
Invented place and street: check Saint Aubrelle and Chemin Ormeau against a map.
